name: mixvpr_v2_progressive_structured_pruning
goal: maximize retrieval quality subject to K210 feasibility

hypotheses.00_large: function-preserving W4/W5/H widening creates usable extra capacity without losing the frozen D4 starting function
hypotheses.01_prune_w5: W5 192->176 contains recoverable redundancy under teacher and parent KD
hypotheses.02_prune_w4: W4 128->120 contains recoverable redundancy after W5 recovery
hypotheses.03_prune_h: mixer hidden 128->112 can reduce cost with recoverable retrieval loss
hypotheses.04_prune_w5: W5 176->160 can cross toward the K210 boundary while preserving strong retrieval quality
hypotheses.05_prune_w4: W4 120->112 can reduce the late backbone further without unacceptable DEV loss
hypotheses.06_prune_h: mixer hidden 112->96 can reach frozen-D4 geometry while retaining the best recoverable quality

compression.stop_rule: stop at first strong Pareto point that passes K210 gates; do not force final compact stage
